nodes.description: Public payable mint function that validates paused, amount limits, supply and payment, then loops minting tokens via nextToken and _safeMint.
onlyOwner function sending the whole contract balance to msg.sender using low-level send, an external value transfer.
Returns metadata URI by concatenating baseURI, token id and baseExtension.
Internal view returning the baseURI state variable.
Overridden internal nextToken that derives a pseudo-random index from block variables including block.timestamp, using the tokenMatrix swap algorithm.
Internal nextToken that returns current counter and increments the token count under the ensureAvailability modifier.
Returns maxSupply minus tokenCount.
Returns the _maxSupply state variable.
Returns the current value of the _tokenCount counter.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and RandomlyAssigned(maxSupply, startFrom).
Internal unrestricted ownership transfer, writes _owner.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner after zero-address check.
onlyOwner function setting ownership to the zero address.
Modifier requiring availableTokenCount() greater than zero before execution.
Public uint256 mint price (30 ether) used in the payment arithmetic of mintSHBSS.
Public uint256 maximum collection supply (1123) enforced in mintSHBSS.
Public uint256 per-transaction mint cap (10) enforced in mintSHBSS.
Public bool pause flag checked at the start of mintSHBSS.
Public string (.json) appended to token URIs.
Public string IPFS base URI returned by _baseURI.
Private Counters.Counter tracking how many tokens have been minted.
Private uint256 holding the maximum token supply.
Private mapping used to track randomly assigned token indices still available.
Private uint256 initial token ID offset added to the assigned value.
Private address storing the contract owner.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, randomness seed, ownership source and withdraw recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as part of the pseudo-random seed in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
External value transfer via payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) in withdraw.
Arithmetic expression cost * _SHBSMintAmount used in the msg.value requirement of mintSHBSS.
Pseudo-random generation from msg.sender/block.coinbase/block.difficulty/block.gaslimit/block.timestamp used to pick a token index.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in mintSHBSS.
Token identifier parameter of tokenURI.
Amount parameter of the ensureAvailabilityFor modifier check.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Local variable holding the token id produced by nextToken inside the mint loop.
Local random index derived from block variables in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Local value selected from tokenMatrix or the generated random index.
Loop counter of the minting for-loop in mintSHBSS.
Local variable caching _baseURI() inside tokenURI.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the _safeMint recipient inside mintSHBSS.
withdraw sends the contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender via an external call.
msg.sender is part of the pseudo-random seed in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken, allowing caller influence.
block.timestamp feeds the random seed, creating miner-influenceable token assignment.
nextToken computes a random index from block variables, the unsafe randomness operation.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken calls super.nextToken() from WithLimitedSupply.
cost is multiplied by the mint amount in the msg.value requirement.
maxSHBS caps totalSupply + amount in mintSHBSS.
maxSHBSMintAmount bounds the mint amount in mintSHBSS.
paused flag gates execution of mintSHBSS.
The cost * amount arithmetic operation is performed inside mintSHBSS.
_SHBSMintAmount drives the payment and supply arithmetic of mintSHBSS.
cost flows into the multiplication performed by the arithmetic unsafe operation.
Caller amount flows into the multiplication performed by the arithmetic unsafe operation.
mintIndex local receives nextToken() output and is used for _safeMint.
Loop counter i controls the minting loop in mintSHBSS.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
currentBaseURI local holds _baseURI() during tokenURI execution.
tokenId parameter is validated and concatenated in tokenURI.
baseExtension is appended to the token URI.
tokenCount reads the _tokenCount counter.
maxSupply returns the _maxSupply state variable.
availableTokenCount calls tokenCount.
availableTokenCount calls maxSupply.
nextToken availability check derives from availableTokenCount through the modifier.
ensureAvailability modifier gates WithLimitedSupply.nextToken.
nextToken increments the _tokenCount counter.
tokenMatrix is read and written in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
startFrom is added to the assigned value in nextToken.
random local variable indexes tokenMatrix in nextToken.
value local variable holds the selected token index in nextToken.
_transferOwnership reads and writes the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership calls _transferOwnership after validation.
renounceOwnership calls _transferOwnership with the zero address.
The deployer msg.sender becomes the initial owner via _transferOwnership(_msgSender()).
newOwner parameter is written to storage by transferOwnership.
withdraw performs the external send unsafe operation.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external send, enabling reentrancy via a malicious receiver.
amount parameter is compared against availableTokenCount in the availability modifier.
Constructor initializes the startFrom token offset.
Constructor sets the _maxSupply value.
mintSHBSS calls nextToken to obtain a token id in its mint loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied mint amount is only meaningful inside mintSHBSS and should be folded into that core function.
tokenId parameter exists solely as input to tokenURI metadata construction.
amount is only used in the availability modifier check and can be merged into the modifier.
newOwner is only used by transferOwnership and should be absorbed into it.
mintIndex is a transient local produced by nextToken within the mint loop.
random is a transient local used only inside RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
value is a transient local used only inside RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Loop counter i is internal bookkeeping of the mint loop in mintSHBSS.
currentBaseURI is a transient local caching _baseURI() inside tokenURI.
